teaching.title: Introductory Programming Teaching Assistant
bullets: Assisted introductory programming lab sessions covering lists and dictionaries, as well as functions.
Answered student questions during office hours and graded programming exercises using an instructor-provided rubric.

projects.title: Quiz Practice Tool
bullets: Implemented a small command-line quiz practice program in Python using functions and collections for an individual course project.
Tested example inputs and documented the program's behaviour, with Git included among the project tools.
